title: Northgate Card Delinquency Thresholds
content:
Two thresholds of days past due apply to every **Northgate Card Credit Accounts (issued by Harbor Point Bank, N.A.)** account, on all six cards alike.

| Threshold | Northgate Secured Card | Northgate Store Card | Northgate Mastercard | Northgate World Mastercard | Northgate Business Store Card | Northgate Business Mastercard |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Days past due at which charging privileges are suspended | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 |
| Days past due at which the account is charged off | 180 | 180 | 180 | 180 | 180 | 180 |

Days past due are counted in calendar days from the payment due date of the oldest statement whose minimum payment remains unmet, to the date being evaluated; they are 0 when every minimum payment due has been met.

Hypothetical illustration: an account whose oldest unmet minimum payment was due 59 days ago is below the 60-day suspension threshold; on the following day it reaches it. An account reaches the charge-off threshold on the day its oldest unmet minimum payment is 180 days past due.
